name: Cartora
tagline: The freight network built for things made by hand.
positioning: Cartora is the logistics fabric for the maker economy — routing small-batch, high-value, irreplaceable goods across an enterprise supply chain that treats every crate like a commission, not a pallet.

hero.h1: Logistics worthy of the things it carries.
hero.sub: Kiln-fired ceramics, hand-loomed textiles, small-batch spirits — the goods that built your brand were never meant for a generic pallet network. Cartora routes them across a chain-of-custody built for the singular and the irreplaceable.

features.title: Provenance-grade tracking
features.description: Every crate carries a signed manifest from the maker's bench to the buyer's dock — humidity, handling, and custody logged as a permanent artifact, not a status ping.

features.title: Handling tiers by object
features.description: Define fragility, orientation, and climate rules per SKU. Cartora matches each shipment to carriers and packers certified for that exact class of craft.

features.title: Fulfillment for the finite
features.description: Made-to-order and limited-run inventory demands its own logic. Reserve, route, and release single units without forcing them into wholesale batch flows.

features.title: Climate-aware routing
features.description: Our engine reroutes around heat waves, freeze lines, and humidity spikes before your lacquer, wax, or fiber ever meets them.

features.title: Restoration guarantee
features.description: On the rare loss, we don't cut a check and move on — we coordinate re-commission with the original maker and cover the lead time.

features.title: Buyer-facing narrative
features.description: Ship a story, not a tracking number. Every delivery arrives with the maker's origin record ready for your customer.

testimonials.quote: We moved 4,000 hand-thrown vessels across three continents last quarter with zero breakage claims. Our old 3PL treated them like coffee mugs. Cartora treats them like the six-week commissions they are.
testimonials.name: Marisol Etxeberria

testimonials.quote: The provenance manifest closed a deal for us. A luxury buyer wanted proof of custody on every loom, and Cartora handed us a signed record before we even asked.
testimonials.name: Desmond Achebe

testimonials.quote: Usage-based pricing means our seasonal spikes don't punish us. We ship 40 barrels one month and 4,000 the next, and the invoice finally makes sense.
testimonials.name: Petra Lindqvist

pricing.blurb: For studios and small houses scaling their first national routes.
For growing brands moving finite inventory at real volume.
For enterprise portfolios spanning multiple maker networks.

homepage.footerBlurb: Cartora is the freight network for the maker economy — treating every hand-made object as the irreplaceable artifact it is, from the bench to the buyer's door.
